Financial_Advisors: JPMorgan Chase & Co , JPMorgan Chase & Co , Deutsche Bank AG , HSBC Holdings Plc , BNP Paribas SA , MUFG Bank Ltd , Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp , Nomura International Plc , Barclays Bank Plc , Citigroup Global Markets Limited , Morgan Stanley Bank International Ltd , Morgan Stanley & Co Ltd (Inactive) , Goldman Sachs International , FGS Global UK Ltd , Evercore Partners International LLP
Legal_Advisors: Sullivan & Cromwell LLP , Linklaters LLP , Fried, Frank, Harris, Shriver & Jacobson LLP , White & Case LLP , Baker & McKenzie LLP , Mori Hamada & Matsumoto , Arthur Cox , Mourant Ozannes , Barbosa, Mussnich & Aragao Advogados , Slaughter and May , Nagashima Ohno & Tsunematsu , Ogier Legal Ltd , Nishimura & Asahi , Ashurst LLP , Latham & Watkins LLP , Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP
Description:
Takeda Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd. (Takeda), a R&D-driven pharmaceutical company, has completion the acquisition of Shire Plc, a biotechnology company, for GBP46 billion (USD62.2 billion). The equivalent value of GBP49.01 (USD66.40) per share values the entire issued and to be issued ordinary share capital of Shire. The transaction has been approved by both companies’ Boards of Directors. The enterprise value of the transaction is USD80.4 billion.

Under the terms of transaction, each Shire shareholder will be entitled to receive USD30.33 in cash for each Shire share and either 0.839 new Takeda shares or 1.678 Takeda American Depositary Shares (ADSs).

The integrated company will continue to be headquartered in Japan. The acquisition is expected to result in Takeda being the only pharmaceutical company listed on both the Tokyo Stock Exchange in Japan, where it will continue to have its primary listing, and the NYSE in the US, enabling it to access two of the capital markets. Takeda has entered into a 364-Day bridge credit agreement for an aggregate principal amount of up to USD30.85 billion to finance funds necessary for the acquisition of Shire.

The acquisition enables Takeda to accelerate its complementary positions in gastrointestinal (GI) and neuroscience; strengthen its position in rare diseases and plasma-derived therapies to complement strength in oncology and focused efforts in vaccines; creates a global, values-based, expand its R&D presence in the Boston area and have major regional locations in Japan, Singapore, Switzerland and the US ; creates a complementary, robust, modality-diverse pipeline and a strengthened R&D engine focused on breakthrough innovation; enhances its cash flow profile, with management confident of delivering substantial annual cost synergies and generating attractive returns for shareholders. In addition, Shire’s portfolio will benefit from Takeda’s strong international presence in emerging markets and Japan.

JP Morgan Chase Bank, National Association, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp and MUFG Bank, Ltd. provided bridge credit finance to Takeda for the acquisition.

Latham & Watkins LLP acted as legal advisor JPMorgan Chase, Sumitomo Mitsui, and MUFG Bank as joint lead arrangers and joint bookrunners of the USD30.85 billion bridge credit facilities.

Citigroup Global Markets Ltd, Goldman Sachs International and Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc acted as financial advisors, while Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP and Slaughter and May acted as legal advisor to Shire. Evercore Partners International LLP, JP Morgan, Nomura International plc and Finsbury Ltd acted as financial advisors and Fried, Frank, Harris, Shriver & Jacobson LLP and Mori Hamada & Matsumoto acted as legal advisor to Takeda

Deal History:

Update: On January 03, 2019, Takeda notes Shire that the Royal Court of Jersey has today sanctioned the scheme of arrangement pursuant to which the proposed acquisition of Shire by Takeda is being implemented.  As previously announced, it is expected that the Scheme will become effective, and that closing of the Acquisition will take place, on January 8, 2019, when a copy of the Jersey Court order is delivered to the registrar of companies in Jersey.

Update: On December 5, 2018, Takeda announced the results of the shareholder votes at its Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (EGM) regarding the recommended acquisition of Shire. Takeda’s proposal to delegate to the Takeda Board the decision regarding the offering terms for the issuance of the new Takeda shares required to implement the proposed acquisition was approved as originally proposed by at least 88% of the votes exercised in respect of this proposal. The Takeda shareholder approval condition required for the acquisition to be implemented has therefore been satisfied.

Update: On November 20, 2018, Takeda Pharma announces that it has received clearance from the European Commission (EC) for the proposed acquisition of Shire. The EC’s approval is conditional on Takeda and Shire fulfilling commitments given to the EC in connection with the clearance. The Acquisition has now received clearances from the EC, the US Federal Trade Commission, the Japan Fair Trade Commission, the State Administration for Market Regulation in China and the Brazilian Administrative Council for Economic Defense, among other regulatory authorities.

Update: On October 18, 2018, Takeda has received unconditional clearance from the Japan Fair Trade Commission for the proposed acquisition of Shire. The receipt of antitrust clearance in Japan is another significant step towards closing the transaction. In addition to Japan, the Acquisition has now received unconditional clearances from regulatory authorities in multiple key jurisdictions, including the US, China and Brazil, among others.

Update: On September 14, 2018, Takeda received unconditional clearance from the State Administration for Market Regulation in China (SAMR) for the proposed acquisition of Shire.

Update: On July 10, 2018,  Takeda Pharma has received unconditional clearance from the US Federal Trade Commission (FTC) for the proposed acquisition of Shire.

Update: On August 28, 2018, Takeda has received unconditional clearance from the Brazilian Administrative Council for Economic Defense. SAMR’s unconditional clearance of the Acquisition is another key step in the transaction process.

Update: On April 24, 2018, Shire had received a further revised proposal from Takeda. The revised proposal comprises 0.839 new Takeda shares and USD30.33 in cash for each Shire ordinary share (the Revised Proposal).

The revised proposal implies an equivalent value of approximately GBP49 (USD68.46) per Shire ordinary share comprising the equivalent of GBP27.26 (USD38) in new Takeda shares and GBP21.75 (USD29.7) in cash.

Update: On April 12, 2018, Takeda made a revised proposal to the Board of Shire to acquire the entire issued and to be issued share capital of Shire, for a price equivalent to GBP46.50 (USD65.96) per share, comprised of GBP17.75 (USD25.18) in cash and GBP28.75 (USD40.78) of new Takeda shares.

Takeda was subsequently notified that the Board of Shire had rejected its proposal. Discussions between the parties regarding a potential offer are ongoing. Takeda and its Board reiterate that it will remain disciplined with respect to the terms of any such offer.

Allergan confirms that it is in the early stages of considering a possible offer for Shire. No offer has been made. Later, in order to comply with the requirements of the UK Takeover Code, Allergan announced that it does not intend to make an offer for Shire. Takeda Pharma will make an approach to Shire regarding a possible offer for the company.

Update: On April 6, 2018, Takeda Pharma considering an offer to acquire Shire in a deal that could be valued at USD55 billion, as per a report published in sources.

Planned: On March 28, 2018, Takeda Pharma intends to acquire Shire, for GBP46 billion (USD64.2 billion).
Deal_Rationale: The acquisition enables Takeda to accelerate its complementary positions in gastrointestinal (GI) and neuroscience; strengthen its position in rare diseases and plasma-derived therapies to complement strength in oncology and focused efforts in vaccines; creates a global, values-based, expand its R&D presence in the Boston area and have major regional locations in Japan, Singapore, Switzerland and the US ; creates a complementary, robust, modality-diverse pipeline and a strengthened R&D engine focused on breakthrough innovation; enhances its cash flow profile, with management confident of delivering substantial annual cost synergies and generating attractive returns for shareholders. In addition, Shire’s portfolio will benefit from Takeda’s strong international presence in emerging markets and Japan.

Description:
Deinove SA, a biotech company that provides compounds from rare bacteria, has acquired Biovertis AG, a biopharmaceutical company, and its subsidiary Morphochem AG, a drug delivery and manufacturing company, for transaction valued approximately EUR0.9 million (USD1.11 million) in shares.

Under the acquisition, Deinove acquires Morphochem and its MCB3837 antibiotic compound program, in particular from specialized investment funds managed by TVM Capital (majority shareholder of Biovertis). MCB3837 is to treat severe gastrointestinal infections caused by clostridium difficile.  

The total value of the rights granted is EUR0.9 million (USD1.11 million) for 500,001 warrants for EUR1.8 (USD2.2) per warrant, i.e. the closing share price on January 17, 2018, which is the last trading day preceding the signature of a letter of intent between the parties. 

The warrants of 8,000,000 is entitling the holder to a maximum of 8,000,000 new Deinove shares, will only be exercisable by their holders in the event of reaching various milestones in the development of the drug candidate. Therefore, the exercise of the warrants is conditional on achieving highly value creating milestones for Deinove alongside the development of the targeted antibiotic compound.

This transaction enables Deinove to strengthen its portfolio of antibiotics in the development and its health activities along with its other activities.

Deal History: 

Announced: On April 13, 2018, Deinove signed a definitive agreement to acquire Biovertis and its subsidiary Morphochem for transaction valued approximately EUR0.9 million (USD1.11 million) in shares.

The acquisition of the entire capital of Biovertis will be achieved through a contribution in kind of shares by Biovertis’s shareholders, option and right holders for the benefit of Deinove. In consideration of this contribution in kind, the contributors, including two specialized investment funds managed by TVM Capital which hold 82.98% of the contributed rights, will receive 500,001 Deinove shares to which will be attached 8,000,000 warrants (Bons d’attribution d'actions, BAA).

Legal_Advisors: Advokatfirman Cederquist KB , Ropes & Gray LLP , Advokatfirman Vinge KB
Description:
Alexion Pharma Nordics Holding AB (Alexion), a subsidiary of Alexion Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing therapies for rare disorders, has acquired all the outstanding shares of Wilson Therapeutics AB, a biopharmaceutical company, for a purchase consideration of SEK7,100 million (USD852.07 million), in a tender offer through cash in hand.

As part of the transaction, Alexion had offered SEK232 per share in cash for each outstanding share of Wilson Therapeutics (representing a total equity value of approximately SEK7,100 million (USD852.07 million) based on the shares outstanding on a fully diluted basis).

In addition, the independent committee of the board of directors of Wilson Therapeutics has unanimously recommended that Wilson Therapeutics’ shareholders accept the offer and Wilson Therapeutics’ four largest shareholders as well as two other shareholders, representing an aggregate of 66.1% of Wilson Therapeutics’ outstanding shares have provided irrevocable undertakings to accept the offer. In addition, one shareholder representing 7.3% of Wilson Therapeutics outstanding shares has expressed its support for the offer and its intention to accept the offer.

In the event that the Alexion, in connection with the offer or otherwise, becomes the owner of more than 90% of the outstanding shares in Wilson Therapeutics on a fully diluted basis (including all issued and outstanding stock options), the Alexion intends to call for compulsory acquisition in accordance with the swedish companies act to acquire all outstanding shares in Wilson Therapeutics and promote a desisting of the shares in Wilson Therapeutics from NASDAQ Stockholm.

BofA Merrill Lynch Asset Holdings, Inc. acted as Alexion's lead financial advisor along with Deutsche Bank AG, DnB Markets Inc acted as Nordic financial advisor and settlement agent, Advokatfirman Cederquist KB acted as legal advisor to Alexion as to Swedish law, while Ropes & Gray LLP acted as legal advisor as to US law in connection with the offer. Lazard acted as financial adviser to Wilson Therapeutics, and Vinge acted as legal counsel to Wilson Therapeutics.

The acquisition allows Alexion to add WTX101, an innovative drug candidate which was in the early stages of Phase III clinical trials for the treatment of patients with Wilson disease, to its clinical pipeline.

Deal History:

Announced: On April 11, 2018, Alexion agreed to acquire all the outstanding shares of Wilson Therapeutics, for a purchase consideration of SEK7,100 million (USD852.07 million), in a tender offer through cash in hand.

Deal_Headline: Thermo Fisher Scientific Acquires 99% Stake in Patheon for USD7.2 Billion
Financial_Advisors: Morgan Stanley  & Co LLC , Goldman Sachs & Co LLC
Legal_Advisors: Blake, Cassels & Graydon LLP , Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP & Affiliates , Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz , Stikeman Elliott LLP
Description:
Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., a biotechnology product development company, has acquired approximately 95.3% stake in Patheon N.V., a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), for purchase consideration of approximately USD7.2 billion. The boards of directors of both the companies have approved transaction. The transaction is expected to be immediately and significantly accretive to adjusted earnings per share (EPS). The deal represents a revenue multiple of 3.78x.

Pursuant to the transaction, Thermo Fisher commenced a tender offer to acquire all of the issued and outstanding shares of Patheon for USD35 per share in cash. The transaction represents a purchase price of approximately USD7.2 billion, which includes the assumption of approximately USD2 billion of net debt. Patheon generated 2016 revenue of approximately USD1.9 billion and will become part of Thermo Fisher's Laboratory Products and Services Segment.

Thermo Fisher also announced the commencement of a subsequent offering period scheduled to expire at 12:01 a.m., New York City time, on September 13, 2017. All ordinary shares validly tendered during the subsequent offering period will be immediately accepted for payment, and tendering holders will thereafter promptly be paid the same form and amount of offer consideration as in the initial offering period. The procedures for tendering shares during the subsequent offering period are described in the Schedule TO and are generally the same as those applicable to the initial offering period, except that the guaranteed delivery procedures may not be used during the subsequent offering period and no withdrawal rights will apply to shares tendered during the subsequent offering period.

On September 13, 2017, American Stock Transfer & Trust Company, LLC, the depositary for the tender offer advised Thermo Fisher that a total of 143,781,162 Patheon ordinary shares, representing approximately 99% of the outstanding Patheon ordinary shares, had been validly tendered.

On August 23, 2017, the European Commission approved the transaction. American Stock Transfer & Trust Company, LLC, the depositary for the tender offer advised Thermo Fisher that 120,161,513 Patheon ordinary shares, representing approximately 82.8% of the outstanding Patheon ordinary shares, had been validly tendered pursuant to the tender offer and not properly withdrawn.

On August 7, 2017, the competition authorities in Brazil approved the transaction, initiating a 15 calendar-day comment period. American Stock Transfer & Trust Company, LLC, the depositary for the tender offer, has advised Thermo Fisher (CN) Luxembourg S.a r.l. that as of 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on August 4, 2017, the last business day prior to the announcement of the extension of the offer, 111,655,983 Patheon ordinary shares, representing approximately 77% of the outstanding Patheon ordinary shares, had been validly tendered pursuant to the tender offer and not properly withdrawn. Patheon shareholders who have already tendered their ordinary shares of Patheon do not have to re-tender their shares or take any other action as a result of the extension of the expiration date of the tender offer.

Thermo Fisher has obtained committed debt financing from Goldman Sachs Bank USA and Goldman Sachs Lending Partners LLC. The company expects to finance the purchase price with debt of approximately USD5.2 billion and equity of approximately USD2 billion.

This transaction enables Thermo Fisher to enter into CDMO market and strengthen its position by adding complementary services.

Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC acted as financial advisor and Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz acted as legal advisor to Thermo Fisher. Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC acted as financial advisor and Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP acted as legal advisor to Patheon for the transaction.

Deal History:

Announced: On May 15, 2017, Thermo Fisher Scientific agreed to acquire Patheon for purchase consideration of approximately USD7.2 billion..

Rumor: On May 14, 2017, Thermo Fisher Scientific intends to acquire Patheon, according to the sources, citing people familiar with the matter.
Deal_Rationale: This transaction enables Thermo Fisher to enter into CDMO market and strengthen its position by adding complementary services.

Deal_Headline: Johnson & Johnson Acquires Actelion for USD30 Billion
Financial_Advisors: Credit Suisse Group AG (Inactive) , Lazard Inc , Citigroup Inc , Bank of America Corp
Legal_Advisors: Niederer Kraft & Frey AG , SextonRiley LLP , Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz , Cravath, Swaine & Moore LLP , Slaughter and May , Freshfields LLP , Homburger AG
Description:
Johnson & Johnson (J&J), a provider of consumer health and personal care products, has announced the completion of the acquisition of Actelion Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, for a consideration of USD30 billion in cash.

The acquisition was completed through an all-cash public tender offer by J&J’s Swiss subsidiary, Janssen Holding GmbH, to acquire all publicly held shares of Actelion for USD280 per share. Actelion will now become part of the Janssen Pharmaceutical Companies of J&J.

As part of the transaction, Actelion has spun off its drug discovery operations and early-stage clinical development assets into a newly created Swiss biopharmaceutical company, Idorsia Ltd (SIX:IDIA). The shares of Idorsia were distributed to Actelion's shareholders as a stock dividend and begin trading on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

J&J will initially hold 9.9% of the shares of Idorsia and, subject to certain limitations, will have the right to an additional 22.1% of Idorsia's outstanding equity through a convertible note.

J&J expects the transaction to add approximately USD1.3 billion in sales for 2017 and be accretive to 2017 adjusted earnings per share by approximately USD0.07. J&J expects the transaction to be accretive to adjusted earnings per share by USD0.35 to USD0.40.2.

The transaction enables J&J to expand its portfolio with leading differentiated in-market medicines and promising late-stage therapies.

Citibank and Lazard acted as financial advisors to J&J, while Cravath, Swaine & Moore LLP, Homburger AG and SextonRiley LLP acted as legal advisors.

Bank of America Merrill Lynch and Credit Suisse acted as financial advisors to Actelion, while Niederer Kraft & Frey, Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz, and Slaughter & May acted as legal advisors to Actelion.

Deal History:

Announced: January 26, 2017, J&J entered into a definitive transaction agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of Actelion for a consideration of USD30 billion in cash. J&J will fund the transaction with cash held outside the US.

On March 31, 2017, At the expiration of the main offer period on March 30, 2017, 10:00 a.m. EDT, 4:00 p.m. CEST, a total of 78,629,955 Actelion shares were tendered, corresponding to 73.25% of the 107,339,642 Actelion shares covered by the tender offer. Including the Actelion shares tendered, Janssen and Actelion, a person acting in concert with Janssen, held as of the end of the main offer period 83,195,346 Actelion shares, corresponding to 77.20% of the voting rights and the share capital of Actelion.

Subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions, Janssen has declared the tender offer successful. The offer represents a premium of: approximately 9% compared to the 52-week intraday high of SEK152 (USD17.2) per Meda share on Nasdaq Stockholm on April 13, 2015 for the 52-week period up to and including February 10, 2016, the last trading day prior to the announcement of the offer; approximately 68% compared to the 90 calendar day volume-weighted average share price of SEK98.5 (USD11.15) per Meda share on Nasdaq Stockholm, up to and including February 10, 2016, the last trading day prior to the announcement of the offer; and approximately 92% compared to the closing share price of SEK86.05 (USD10.19) per Meda share on Nasdaq Stockholm on February 10, 2016, the last trading day prior to the announcement of the offer.

This transaction enables Mylan to strengthens its position as a diversified global pharmaceutical with an expansive and growing portfolio of specialty, generic and OTC products and a complementary therapeutic presence.

Centerview Partners LLC acted as financial advisor, Cravath, Swaine & Moore LLP acted as legal advisor, Vinge KB acted as legal advisor in Sweden and NautaDutilh N.V. acted as legal advisor in the Netherlands to Mylan; while Rothschild Nordic AB acted as financial advisor and Mannheimer Swartling Advokatbyra AB acted as legal advisor to Meda for the transaction.

Deal History: 

Update: On August 2, 2016, Mylan announced that its recommended public offer to the shareholders of Meda to tender all their shares in Meda to Mylan has been accepted by shareholders holding an aggregate of 342,578,694 shares, corresponding to approximately 94% of the total number of outstanding shares and votes in Meda, as of July 29, 2016. As all conditions to the offer have been fulfilled, including the condition with respect to the 90% acceptance level, Mylan has declared the offer unconditional and will complete the offer. Settlement in respect of the Meda shares duly tendered by July 29, 2016 is expected to occur on or around August 5, 2016. 

Update: On July 27, 2016, Mylan announced that the US Federal Trade Commission (FTC) has cleared its proposed transaction to acquire Meda, subject to Mylan's divestiture of certain products not significant to Mylan's earnings following the consummation of its recommended public offer to the shareholders of Meda to tender all their shares in Meda to Mylan.

The FTC clearance represents the final regulatory clearance required to complete the offer and Mylan has now received all antitrust regulatory clearances required to acquire Meda. As a result, completion of the offer is no longer conditional upon receipt of further regulatory or government clearances.

Update: On July 20, 2016, The European Commission (EC) has approved under the EU Merger Regulation the proposed acquisition of Meda by Mylan, subject to conditions. The decision is conditional upon the divestment of a number of Mylan's or Meda's businesses in Austria, Belgium, Estonia, France, Luxembourg, Ireland, Italy, Norway, Portugal, Spain and the UK. The Commission had concerns that the transaction, as initially notified, would have reduced competition on the markets for several pharmaceutical products. The commitments offered by Mylan address these concerns.

Update: On June 16, 2016, Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority (Sw: Finans-inspektionen) has approved the tender of all Meda shares in Meda to Mylan. The acceptance period for the offer runs from and including June 17, 2016 up to and including July 29, 2016. Settlement is expected to commence around August 10, 2016. Mylan reserves the right to extend the acceptance period and, to the extent necessary and permissible, will do so in order for the acceptance period to cover applicable decision-making procedures at relevant authorities. Mylan also reserves the right to postpone the settlement date.

Announced: On February 10, 2016, Mylan agreed to acquire Meda for a purchase consideration of SEK83.6 billion (USD9.9 billion) including debt or SEK165 (USD19.55) per Meda share.

Reportedly, the deal could be worth about USD1 billion and may attract interest from pharmaceutical companies with an interest in respiratory treatments.

Rejected: On April 4, 2014, Meda rejected the takeover offer by Mylan.

Planned: On April 3, 2014, Mylan made a takeover offer to acquire Meda for a purchase consideration of approximately USD4.5 billion.

Sorin S.p.A. (also Sorin Group), a medical device company, has merged with Cyberonics Inc., a developer of vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) therapy system, in an all-stock transaction. The merger has been unanimously approved by the boards of directors of both companies. 

Under the agreement, the merger created a new holding company focused on medical technologies known as LivaNova PLC with a combined equity value of approximately USD2.7 billion based on the closing price of Sorin and Cyberonics shares on February 25, 2015. LivaNova began trading on the NASDAQ and London Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol 'LIVN'. Each Cyberonics stockholder received one ordinary share of new holding company for every share of Cyberonics owned. Each Sorin shareholder received a fixed ratio of 0.0472 ordinary shares of LivaNova for every Sorin share owned. Following the transaction, assuming no withdrawal rights under Italian law are exercised by Sorin shareholders with respect to the agreement, Sorin shareholders own approximately 46% of LivaNova, and Cyberonics shareholders hold approximately 54% on a fully diluted basis.

Following the transaction, Andre-Michel Ballester, CEO of Sorin, will serve as CEO of new holding company and Dan Moore, CEO of Cyberonics, will become non-executive chairman of new holding company. The board of directors of new holding company will be equally balanced between Sorin and Cyberonics, with four directors designated by Sorin and four by Cyberonics. One additional board member will be jointly selected. New holding company will operate as three business units: Cardiac Surgery, Cardiac Rhythm Management and Neuromodulation, with operating headquarters in Mirandola (Italy), Clamart (France) and Houston (US) respectively.

The agreement was implemented through two mergers occurring in immediate succession: first, Sorin was merged with and into new company by means of an EU cross-border merger, with new company as the surviving company in the merger, and immediately thereafter, a wholly owned subsidiary of new company was merged with and into Cyberonics, with Cyberonics surviving the merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of new company. At the closing of the transaction, Cyberonics shares ceased trading on NASDAQ and Sorin shares ceased trading on the Borsa Italiana (MTA). 

In parallel, Mittel S.p.A. and Equinox Two S.C.A., which control Bios S.p.A. and Tower 6 Bis S.a.r.l., holding in total 25.6% of Sorin's outstanding shares, have entered into a support agreement with Cyberonics pursuant to which they have agreed to vote in favor of the transaction and not to sell their shares until the closing of the transaction. Mittel and Equinox Two are expected to hold approximately 11.5% of new holding company's ordinary shares following the closing of the agreement. In addition, the chairman and CEO of each of Sorin and Cyberonics have also entered into support agreements in favor of the agreement.

This transaction enables Sorin and Cyberonics to provide treatments for cardiac surgery and neuromodulation with a diversified product portfolio.

Rothschild S.p.A acted as financial advisor and Latham & Watkins LLP acted as legal advisor to Sorin. Description:

This transaction complements Roche's portfolio in neuromuscular disease and enable to develop medicines for spinal muscular atrophy.

Description:

Our objective is to provide affordable treatment to help patients have an acceptable quality of life while dealing with the disease.”
Deal_Rationale: This transaction enables Care Oncology Clinic to develop and provide treatments to the patients with cancer.

Deal_Headline: Vectura Acquires Activaero, Medical Device Company, For US$181 Million
Description:
Vectura Group plc, a pulmonary drug development company, acquired Activaero GmbH (formerly Inamed GmbH), a medical device company, for a purchase consideration of €130m (US$180.93m). The company will fund the acquisition cost through a combination of existing cash and equity. Of the total consideration, the amount of €95m (US$132.2m) payable at completion, comprising €45m (US$62.6m) in cash and €50m (US$69.6m) in new Vectura ordinary shares; and €35m (US$48.7m) deferred (non-contingent) cash consideration payable on August 1, 2015 (or the next business day thereafter). In addition, the existing shareholders of Activaero may receive additional payments of up to a cap of €6m (US$8.35m) in relation to future transactions involving Activaero's technology.
The shareholders of Activaero will receive 25,641,398 new Vectura ordinary shares at a price £1.61 (US$2.24m) per share, upon completion. Pursuant to the acquisition, major shareholders of Activaero will be subject to lock-up agreements of 12 months. Any trading in respect of the shares held by Activaero's shareholders during the six months following the lock-up period shall be through Vectura's brokers. Application will be made to the London Stock Exchange for these shares to be listed on the premium segment of the Official List and admitted to trading on the main market and it is expected that dealings will commence on March 18, 2014. These shares will rank pari passu in all respects with the existing issued ordinary shares in Vectura. 
Activaero is focused on the development of products for the treatment of respiratory diseases. Its proprietary smart nebuliser-based technology (Flow And Volume Regulated Inhalation Technology) allows drug deposition into targeted areas of the lung and is currently utilised in seven clinical and several preclinical stage programmes. Flow And Volume Regulated Inhalation Technology (Favorite) is a smart nebuliser-based inhalation technology that provides for more efficient drug utilisation and targeting through pre-selection of drug into the desired deposition area.
This transaction provides Vectura an opportunity for a new product development, including products in late-stage development; enables to extend its technology platform into smart nebuliser-based technology, broadening its therapeutic offering by opening up possibilities for new drug-device products and partnerships. In addition, this transaction provided Vectura an enhanced medium and long-term growth profile; accelerated revenue growth with EBITDA growth profile remaining broadly in-line over a five year period; double digit returns on investment; and near-term synergies of approximately €1.5m (US$2.08m), resulting from reducing duplicate head office and administrative costs.
N M Rothschild & Sons Limited acted as financial advisor to Vectura for the transaction.
Chris Blackwell, CEO of Vectura, said,” We are determined to build further value in our Company and this transaction represents an important step towards building a sustainable specialty pharma business. The acquisition is highly complementary to Vectura's core capabilities, in-line with our strategic priorities and, I believe, will enable us to build a therapeutic specialist in airways diseases. With this transaction, we create a much stronger entity with a balanced offering of products and technologies, both partnered and un-partnered. Our considerably deeper pipeline and new partnerships will provide us with the opportunity to drive organic growth. We see significant value in the combination of our respective respiratory expertise and believe that the combined company is well positioned to extract even more value from our broader technology base and potentially retain greater economics from pipeline assets."
Gerhard Scheuch, founder and CEO of Activaero, said, “Vectura is well positioned to develop Activaero's assets using its development expertise and building on its success in deriving value from its products. Our corporate partners and patients will greatly benefit from the new joint organization. It will allow us to even better serve our clients by offering a broader spectrum of innovative therapeutic options and services going forward. I am pleased to be able to continue my involvement in this organization."
Deal_Rationale: This transaction provides Vectura an opportunity for a new product development, including products in late-stage development; enables to extend its technology platform into smart nebuliser-based technology, broadening its therapeutic offering by opening up possibilities for new drug-device products and partnerships.

Deal_Headline: The Medicines Company acquires 100% stake in ProFibrix
Financial_Advisors: Barclays Plc , Bank of America Corp
Legal_Advisors: Wilmer Cutler Pickering Hale and Dorr LLP , Dechert LLP
Description:
The Medicines Company, a US-based provider of medical solutions, has acquired all of the outstanding capital stock of ProFibrix, BV, a Netherlands-based biotechnology company.

_x000D_Earlier, ProFibrix had secured funding from Index Ventures LLP, Gilde Healthcare Partners B.V., Vesalius Biocapital Partners S.a r.l. and Inkef Capital. 

_x000D_Announcement (June 04, 2013):
_x000D_The Medicines Company has signed an agreement to acquire all of the outstanding capital stock of ProFibrix. 

_x000D_ The acquisition is subjected to The Medicines Company's satisfactory review of the pending Phase 3 clinical trial results of ProFibrix's lead biologic, Fibrocaps(TM), a dry powder topical formulation of fibrinogen and thrombin being developed to stop bleeding during surgery. The Phase 3 trial, FINISH-3, has completed enrollment of 719 surgical patients with mild to moderate surgical bleeding.

_x000D_Under the terms of the agreement, The Medicines Company will pay ProFibrix a $10 million upfront option payment. If The Medicines Company proceeds to closing, it would be obligated to make a $90 million cash payment to the ProFibrix equity holders at closing. The Medicines Company also would be obligated to pay up to an aggregate of $140 million in cash to the equity holders upon the achievement of contingent US and European regulatory approval. If The Medicines Company is satisfied with the trial results of FINISH-3 and determines to proceed, it will purchase all of the outstanding capital stock of ProFibrix at closing.

_x000D_Barclays PLC is acting as financial advisor and Dechert LLP  is acting as legal advisor to ProFibrix. Bank of America Corporation is acting as financial advisor, and Wilmer Cutler Pickering Hale and Dorr LLP is acting as legal advisor to The Medicines Company on the transaction.
Deal_Rationale: According to The Medicines, "this transaction will allow it to leverage the frontline activities in surgery centers at leading US hospitals and potentially accelerate the entry into the European market."

Deal_Headline: Isotechnika Pharma merges with Aurinia Pharmaceuticals
Target_Raw: Isotechnika Pharma, Inc.; Aurinia Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
Description:
Isotechnika Pharma, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of novel immunosuppressive therapeutics, has merged with Aurinia Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a pharmaceutical company focused on the nephrology market. Both the entities are based in Canada. 

_x000D_Isotechnika will conduct business as Aurinia and will change its name to Aurinia Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 

_x000D_In connection with the merger transactions, Isotechnika has completed a private placement of 133,333,332 units, comprised of one common share and one half of a full warrant, at a price of CAD0.045 ($0.043) per unit for gross proceeds of CAD6 million ($5.82). 

_x000D_The financing included investments by established life-science investment funds, Lumira Capital and Difference Capital, with participation from ILJIN Life Science Co. Ltd. and various other investors. 

_x000D_Update on August 15, 2013: 
_x000D_The shareholders of Isotechnika have approved the proposed transaction to merge with Aurinia. 

_x000D_Announcement (February 5, 2013): 
_x000D_Isotechnika and Aurinia have signed a binding term sheet (Term Sheet) for the merger of the two companies, creating a clinical stage pharmaceutical company focused on the global nephrology market. 

_x000D_ Aurinia's lupus rights and database will be combined in the newly merged company with the transplantation and autoimmune rights, and the database held by Isotechnika. 

_x000D_The Term Sheet sets forth the main criteria to be incorporated into a definitive merger agreement under which Isotechnika will acquire 100% of the outstanding securities of Aurinia. The merger is expected to be effected by an exchange of Isotechnika shares for securities of Aurinia, resulting in a 60:40 post-merger ownership split between Isotechnika and Aurinia, respectively. 

_x000D_In addition, Isotechnika and Aurinia have negotiated a tripartite settlement with ILJIN Life Science Co. Ltd. (ILJIN) pursuant to which, upon the successful completion of the proposed merger, the combined company will re-acquire full rights to voclosporin for autoimmune indications including lupus, and transplantation in the United States, Europe and other regions of the world, outside of Canada, Israel, South Africa, China, Taiwan and Hong Kong. In return, ILJIN will be entitled to receive certain pre-defined future milestone payments in the aggregate amount of CAD10 million ($10.3 million), plus up to CAD1.6 million ($1.6 million) upon the new company reaching certain financing milestones. ILJIN will own 25% of the issued and outstanding shares of the merged company. 

_x000D_The transaction is subject to certain closing conditions including, among others, the negotiation and completion of a merger agreement, acceptance and approval by the Toronto Stock Exchange (the TSX), the approval of Isotechnika's shareholders and Isotechnika securing a minimum of CAD3 million ($3 million) in debt or equity financing satisfactory for it to fulfill its obligations as contemplated by the Term Sheet. 

_x000D_The companies currently expect that a formal merger agreement will be negotiated and executed before March 15, 2013. The merged entity will adopt Aurinia Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as its new corporate name.
Deal_Rationale: This combination provides a foundation upon which to build a voclosporin franchise within the area of nephrology. In addition to the significant cost synergies provided by the merger, the Aurinia team brings an expertise in lupus nephritis to the table.

Deal_Headline: BASF acquires 98.19% stake in Pronova BioPharma
Description:
BASF AG, a Germany-based chemical company, has acquired Pronova BioPharma ASA, a Norway-based developer and manufacturer of omega-3 fatty acids. 

_x000D_Following the transaction, the tendered shares were transferred to BASF, and BASF will now hold a 98.19%  stake in Pronova. 

_x000D_BASF will fully integrate Pronova into its nutrition and health division and Pronova will become a part of BASF’s omega-3-business. 

_x000D_Update on January 15, 2013: 
_x000D_BASF has confirmed its offer to acquire all of the issued and outstanding shares of Pronova and has increased its cash offer price to NOK13.5 ($2.45) per share. 

_x000D_The transaction is now valued at approximately NOK4,996 million ($903.08 million). The offer price represents a premium of 7.14% to Pronova’s closing share price on January 14, 2013. The offer period expires on January 18, 2013 and will not be extended. 

_x000D_As of January 14, 2013, BASF has received acceptances under the voluntary offer for a number of shares representing approximately 70% of the issued shares and votes in Pronova. 

_x000D_Except for Herkules Private Equity (Jersey-I) L.P. and Herkules Private Equity (Jersey-II) L.P. all shareholders including those who have tendered their shares till January 15, 2013 will be entitled to receive the increased offer price. 

_x000D_Update on December 19, 2012: 
_x000D_BASF has extended its offer period to acquire all of the issued and outstanding shares of Pronova for NOK12.5 ($2.17) per share in cash until January 18, 2013. 

_x000D_BASF has received acceptances under the voluntary offer for a number of shares representing approximately 67.2% of the issued shares and votes in Pronova. 

_x000D_The Board of Directors of Pronova and the management unanimously support BASF’s offer and recommend its acceptance. 

_x000D_Announcement (November 21, 2012): 
_x000D_ BASF has entered into an agreement to make a recommended voluntary public takeover offer to acquire Pronova for NOK12.5 ($2.17) per share in cash. The transaction is valued at approximately NOK4, 845 million ($844.44 million). 

_x000D_The offer price represents a premium of 4.17% to Pronova’s closing share price on November 20, 2012. The Board of Directors of Pronova and the management unanimously support BASF’s offer and recommend its acceptance. 

_x000D_In addition, BASF has obtained irrevocable pre-acceptance commitments for approximately 60% of Pronova’s share capital; including the 50% stake held by majority shareholders Herkules Private Equity Fund (held through its funds Herkules Private Equity (Jersey-I) L.P. and Herkules Private Equity (Jersey-II) L.P.), an approximately 9.1% stake indirectly controlled by investment firms Kistefos AS and Kistefos Investment AS and 0.3% held by members of the Board of Directors and management of Pronova. 

_x000D_The acquisition will be financed by way of available resources of BASF. The offer will be made by BASF’s wholly-owned subsidiary BASF AS and will be subject to certain conditions, including inter alia that shareholders shall in the aggregate have accepted the offer for a number of shares representing more than 90% of the total share capital of Pronova, and the same amount of votes which can be exercised in the general meeting of Pronova and that there shall have been no occurrence of a material adverse change. 

_x000D_Morgan Stanley & Co. Limited is acting as financial advisor to Pronova. 

_x000D_BASF expects to finalize the transaction in the first quarter of 2013.
Deal_Rationale: The intended acquisition will significantly strengthen BASF's position in the market for omega-3 fatty acids. The combination will enable Pronova to further leverage its omega-3 research, product development and manufacturing capabilities through BASF’s global platform and resources.

Description:

_x000D_ Upsher-Smith is a US-based pharmaceutical company.  The acquisition was approved by Proximagen’s shareholders.

_x000D_ Upsher-Smith has received an approval from the High Court of Justice in England and Wales to acquire the entire issued share capital of Proximagen.

_x000D_Upsher-Smith has reached an agreement to acquire the entire issued share capital of Proximagen.

_x000D_The acquisition excluding the CVRs values Proximagen's fully diluted share capital at approximately GBP223 million  on the basis of a fully diluted share capital of 69,689,794 Proximagen shares. _x000D_ The cash consideration payable by USL under the acquisition will be funded from cash on the balance sheet of the Upsher-Smith and new debt facilities arranged by J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, U.S. Bank National Association and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC in the form of a $300 million secured credit agreement to be provided by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., U.S. Bank National Association and Wells Fargo Bank, National Association to Upsher-Smith.

_x000D_Upsher-Smith has obtained irrevocable undertakings from Proximagen shareholders to accept the deal in respect of 72.01% of the share capital, including from Proximagen’s largest shareholder, Invesco Asset Management Limited, a UK-based asset management company.

_x000D_ J.P. Morgan Cazenove, Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP and Kovak-Likly Communications are acting as financial, legal and PR advisors to Upsher-Smith. WG Partners is acting as financial advisor, while Cenkos Securities plc is acting as nominated advisor and broker to Proximagen. Pinsent Masons LLP, Reed Smith LLP and M:Communications are acting as legal and PR advisors to Proximagen.
